_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the ICE18 panel. Import it under Admin -> Nests -> Import Egg.
name: ICE18 Panel
author: ice18@example.com
description: ICE18 server panel. Runs on top of this Pterodactyl panel through its API and never deletes, reinstalls or wipes Pterodactyl servers. Updates itself from git.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ICE18 panel install script.
# Pterodactyl runs this in a temporary container with the server's folder mounted at /mnt/server.
# It only touches the ICE18 panel's own server folder. Your .env file (if any) is kept.
set -euo pipefail

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/HuzzySnuzzy/ice18}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

cd /mnt/server
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
  echo "Updating ICE18 from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
  git fetch --depth 1 origin "${BRANCH}"
  git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
else
  echo "Downloading ICE18 from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
  rm -rf /tmp/ice18
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /tmp/ice18
  cp -a /tmp/ice18/. /mnt/server/
fi

export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
corepack enable
# Copy packages into node_modules: the pnpm store in this temporary container is thrown away.
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --config.package-import-method=copy
pnpm build

echo "ICE18 installed. Start the server to launch the panel."

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch to install. Reinstall the server to update.

variables.name: Automatic updates
variables.description: Install new ICE18 versions from git automatically: on every start, and while running. Only ICE18's own folder is updated; a failed update rolls back.

variables.name: Update check interval
variables.description: How often (in minutes) a running ICE18 checks for a new version.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: ICE18's own MySQL/MariaDB database, e.g. mysql://user:password@172.18.0.1:3306/s1_ice18. Create one in this server's Databases tab.

variables.name: App secret
variables.description: Random string of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Signs login sessions.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The address people open ICE18 at, e.g. https://ice18.example.com. Leave empty to allow the address in the browser's Host header.

variables.name: Pterodactyl URL
variables.description: Your Pterodactyl panel's address, e.g. https://panel.example.com

variables.name: Pterodactyl application key
variables.description: Admin -> Application API key with read access to servers, users, nodes, locations, nests and eggs.

variables.name: Pterodactyl client key
variables.description: Client API key of a root admin account (Account -> API Credentials). Used for power actions and consoles.

variables.name: Open registration
variables.description: Let anyone create an ICE18 account. The first account is always allowed and becomes the admin.

variables.name: Secure cookies
variables.description: Set to true when ICE18 is served over HTTPS.

variables.name: Behind a reverse proxy
variables.description: Set to true when Nginx, Caddy or Cloudflare sits in front of ICE18.
